Ardiles / Brand Strategist / 2025–present

Marketing for Ardiles Running and Basketball.

I lead a three-person brand team and help turn consumer research into product launches, retail communication, and community activations.

3-person brand team
30+ product launchesView detailsHide details+
Context
Marketing for the Running and Basketball categories, covering product launches, campaigns, partnerships, and retail activity.
My role
Lead a three-person brand team. Coordinate product, design, production, sales, and community teams. Manage partner responsibilities, costs, schedules, and reporting.
Work scope
Across my Ardiles roles, I supported 30+ product launches. Running and Basketball together represent Rp30B+ in annual category revenue.

From brand direction to community participation

Brand direction. Ardiles used Go For It! in earlier messaging. Move Your Way puts more emphasis on how people choose to move. For Running and Basketball, I use consumer research to help shape positioning and product communication.

Product launches. I coordinated product information, creator communication, and retail materials for Runergize, and supported phased launch content for Speedy Weeedy Retrodrive. For Love & Hustle, I worked on the launch story for the collaboration between athlete Widyanta Putra Teja and artist Kevinswork.

Community participation. That work took different forms, from product trials with Team 530 and basketball content with the Indonesian Basketball League to event communication at Urban Sneaker Society and Jakarta Sneakers Day and athlete-led content with Indonesian Deaf Basketball.

Measurement. The Love & Hustle campaign reported selling out its 200-pair early-access allocation. The Team 530 event recorded 30+ attendees and 20+ products tested. Account growth is reported separately from individual campaign results.

Research, product marketing & operations

Consumer research, category positioning, product messaging, and operating frameworks form part of the strategic work behind these campaigns.
